footer_tagline: Connecting communities, one helping hand at a time.
hero_subtitle: A trusted platform connecting elderly, injured, and people in need with verified local helpers for everyday errands — safely and free.
section_how_it_works_subtitle: Getting help or giving help takes less than two minutes.
step_submit_desc: Fill in your name, location, and what you need help with. Takes under a minute.
step_find_desc: Local helpers browse open requests and accept the ones they can help with.
step_contact_desc: The helper calls you directly to coordinate time, place, and specifics.
step_complete_desc: Errand is done and marked complete. You can track status anytime with your ID.
section_services_subtitle: Our helpers assist with a wide range of daily tasks.
service_grocery_desc: Getting vegetables, fruits, groceries, and household essentials from the market.
service_medicine_desc: Picking up prescriptions and medicines from pharmacies and medical stores.
service_bill_desc: Assisting with electricity, water, phone, and other bill payments in person.
service_travel_desc: Accompanying elderly or recovering patients to hospital and clinic appointments.
service_errand_desc: Post office visits, document submissions, and other daily tasks.
service_other_desc: Have something else in mind? Submit a request and describe your need — we'll find help.
who_elderly_desc: Senior citizens who need support with physical tasks and daily errands.
who_injured_desc: People recovering from accidents or surgery who have limited mobility.
who_parents_desc: Pregnant women and new mothers who need extra support at home.
who_alone_desc: Individuals without family nearby who need occasional assistance.
cta_subtitle: Join our network of helpers and help someone in your neighbourhood today.
auth_login_subtitle: Sign in to your account and get directed to your personalized dashboard based on your role.
auth_login_feature_1_desc: Automatically routed to your dashboard upon login.
auth_login_feature_2_desc: Your account is protected by encrypted authentication.
auth_login_feature_3_desc: Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
auth_signup_hero_subtitle: Register as a user or helper and start helping your neighborhood with a polished, secure experience.
auth_signup_feature_1_desc: Fast account creation with clear onboarding steps.
auth_signup_feature_2_desc: Join a trusted network of helpers and requesters.
auth_signup_admin_note: Admin accounts are created by the system. Please use the admin portal if you need administrator access.
signup_password_hint: Minimum 6 characters. Use numbers and symbols for strength.
signup_role_user_desc: Join as a user and submit requests.
dashboard_welcome_subtitle: Thank you for supporting your community and helping people in need.
dashboard_try_filters: Try changing your filters or check back later.
dashboard_requests_submitted_as_helper: Requests you've submitted as a helper needing help
dashboard_overview_subtitle: Track your current tasks, recent activity, and request progress from one place.
request_help_subtitle: Tell us what you need — a helper will reach out to you shortly.
request_help_phone_contact: You will be contacted on your phone number
request_help_track_with_id: Track your request with your ID
request_help_information_private: Your information is kept private and only shared with the helper who accepts your request.
track_page_subtitle: View the current status of your request.
about_subtitle: Our story, mission, and the team behind Help R Circle.
about_mission_heading: Bridging the Gap in Community Support
about_mission_paragraph_1: Every day, many elderly people, recovering patients, pregnant women, and those living alone struggle with simple errands like grocery shopping, medicine collection, or bill payment.
about_mission_paragraph_2: Help R Circle was created to close that gap by connecting those who need everyday support with verified local helpers from their own neighbourhood.
about_mission_paragraph_3: Our platform is free, easy to use, and designed for seniors and families — with clear steps, readable text, and no confusing setup.
about_problem_item_1: Elderly people unable to travel to markets or hospitals.
about_problem_item_2: Injured individuals with no family nearby.
about_problem_item_3: New mothers overwhelmed with household responsibilities.
about_problem_item_4: Existing platforms are too complex or expensive.
about_solution_item_1: A simple free web platform with no app download required.
about_solution_item_2: Local helpers from your own neighbourhood are ready to serve.
about_solution_item_3: Real-time status tracking keeps you informed at every step.
about_solution_item_4: Built for accessibility with easy navigation and clear text.
about_value_safety_desc: All interactions prioritise the safety and dignity of people seeking help.
about_value_free_desc: No charges, no subscriptions. The service is free for everyone, always.
about_value_community_desc: Built by the community, for the community. Every helper matters.
about_value_accessible_desc: Designed with large fonts and simple navigation for elderly users.
contact_subtitle: Have a question or feedback? We'd love to hear from you.
contact_page_subtitle: Have a question, suggestion, or need assistance? We'd love to hear from you.
contact_support_card_text: From help requests to feedback and partnerships, our team is ready to guide you with care and clarity.
contact_reasons_title: Choose the reason that fits your message
contact_reasons_subtitle: We make it easy to reach the right place with the right support.
contact_reason_need_help_desc: Ask for assistance with everyday needs and local support.
contact_reason_tech_desc: Share bugs or issues so we can improve the experience.
contact_reason_feedback_desc: Tell us what is working well and how we can do better.
contact_reason_helper_desc: Join the Help R Circle community and offer support.
contact_reason_partnership_desc: Explore ways to collaborate for stronger local impact.
contact_reason_general_desc: Ask about the service, process, or how to get started.
contact_hero_support_text: Send us a message and our team will get back to you with the help you need.
contact_quick_tip_summary: Scroll down to the FAQ section for quick answers before sending your message.
contact_form_subtitle: We usually reply within one business day and appreciate every message you send.
contact_quick_tip_1: Mention your location so we can guide you better.
contact_quick_tip_2: Share the best phone number for a quick reply.
contact_quick_tip_3: For urgent help, use the request-help option as well.
contact_faq_subtitle: A few quick answers before you send your message.
contact_faq_a1: You can use the Request Help page to share your location, contact details, and the assistance you need.
contact_faq_q2: How do I become a Helper?
contact_faq_a2: Visit the Helper page and fill in your details so the community can connect with you.
contact_faq_q3: Is Help R Circle free to use?
contact_faq_a3: Yes, the platform is designed to help communities freely and locally.
contact_faq_q4: How long does it take to receive a response?
contact_faq_a4: Most messages receive a response within 24 hours, depending on the request type.
contact_closing_title: Every message helps us improve Help R Circle
contact_closing_text: Every message helps us improve Help R Circle and build a stronger community. Thank you for reaching out!
contact_closing_body: Thank you for reaching out! Your feedback and questions help us keep this platform strong, supportive, and safe for everyone.
